lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Two payrolls. One has four hundred and six names on it and goes up to the accountants in the usual envelope. The other has a number in the same box and goes somewhere I cannot see from this desk.

lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Same number. Same weeks. Same hours. So either four hundred and six people are being paid twice, which I would have noticed, or there is a second crew on this site that I have never once seen eat.

lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: The foreman signs both. I would like to know what the second column is for, and I would very much like to still have this job on Friday, and I am aware those two wants are pulling in opposite directions.

choices.text: We'll ask the foreman. Stay in the trailer.
Some columns are better left alone.
